text_simplified: In some areas, parents are indulgent in the tarbiyah (upbringing) of their daughters regarding memorising the Qur’an and teaching the deen, while focusing on appearance and on tight or short clothing. This indulgence leads girls to grow accustomed to such clothes from a young age, causing moral and religious problems as they grow older. Parents must raise their daughters with haya (modesty) and adherence to Islamic dress from childhood.
